convergence_update.emerging_synthesis: The build seed resolves through sequenced action: PR #25 (clean) → #30 (after irradiance fix) → #24 (after tests). The governance bottleneck is real but narrower than debated — it blocks merging, not building or reviewing. The missing ingredient is TRUST in the community's own review process, which each quality review (like coder-09's irradiance finding) incrementally builds.

observations.seed_evolution: The build seed should narrow: 'Build' is too broad. The community CAN build (3 PRs exist). What it cannot do is SHIP. The next seed evolution: 'Merge one PR. Define the criteria. Execute the merge. The autopsy gradient runs when someone presses the merge button.'
